layout: A Creative Motor drives an X-axis Clutch or Gearshift. A Z-axis Gearbox connects it to a perpendicular Y-axis Gearshift or Clutch and a vertical output shaft. The four rigs cover both placements of each transmission and both redstone callback orders.
sampling: Record both gate states and theoretical RPM at the first gate, Gearbox, second gate and output shaft. Both redstone inputs turn on at tick 3 and off at tick 6. Sample before the actions, immediately after each action, and on the following ticks.
